prompt: Add up the cubes of each whole number from 1 to 5, then print that total.
title: Cube total

prompt: Multiply together every whole number from 1 to 6 and print the product.
title: Factorial of six

prompt: Count how many whole numbers from 1 to 36 divide 36 exactly, and print the count.
title: Divisor tally

prompt: A sequence begins 1, 1 and each later term is the sum of the two before it. Print its tenth term.
title: Tenth Fibonacci

prompt: Print the total of all even numbers between 1 and 20 inclusive.
title: Even total

prompt: Find the biggest power of two that does not exceed 100, and print it.
title: Largest power of two

prompt: Take the number 9875 and print the sum of its individual digits.
title: Digit total

prompt: Count the numbers from 1 to 50 that divide evenly by three or by five, and print how many there are.
title: Multiples of three or five

prompt: Print the number 1234 with its digits in the opposite order.
title: Digits backwards

prompt: Decide whether 91 has any divisor other than 1 and itself. Print yes if it is prime and no otherwise.
title: Primality of ninety-one

prompt: A point sits at one across and five up. Make a second point with the same height but ten across, then print its two numbers added together.
title: Shifted point

prompt: Write a helper that hands back the second entry of a list when there is one. Run it on 7, 8 and 9 and print what comes back, or none if nothing does.
title: Second entry or nothing

prompt: Write a helper that divides one number by another and refuses when the second is zero. Divide twenty by four and print the answer, or bad when it refuses.
title: Guarded division

prompt: A rectangle starts two wide and three tall. Change its width to five, then print the area it now covers.
title: Widened rectangle

prompt: A device holds a sensor, and the sensor holds a reading that starts at zero. Set that reading to seven and print it.
title: Buried setting

prompt: A shape is either a square described by its side or a circle described by its radius. Print the area of a square of side four, using three as the value of pi.
title: Shape area
Sorted measurements
prompt: The measurements 9, 2, 7 and 4 arrived out of order. Print them from smallest to largest, each on its own line.

title: Ends exchanged
prompt: A queue holds 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 in order. Exchange the first and last entries, then print the queue one entry per line.

title: Running total
prompt: Walk through the deposits 3, 1, 4, 1 and 5 in order, printing the balance after each one lands, one balance per line.

title: First and final
prompt: A log holds the entries 6, 7, 8 and 9 in order. Print the entry it starts with, then the entry it ends with.

title: Split by cutoff
prompt: Given the samples 5, 12, 3, 18 and 9 with a cutoff of ten: print how many fall under the cutoff, then how many sit at or over it.

title: Spread of the data
prompt: For the figures 8, 3, 11 and 6: print the smallest figure, then the gap between the largest and the smallest.

title: Descending order
prompt: Arrange the scores 2, 9 and 5 from highest to lowest and print each score on a line of its own.

title: Opening and closing letters
prompt: Look at the word granite. Print the letter it opens with, then the letter it closes with, each on its own line.

title: Finding the letter
prompt: Within the word banana, print every position where the letter n lives, counting from zero, one position per line.

title: Mirrored word
prompt: Take the word drum. Print it with its letters running back to front, then print it as it normally reads.

title: Vowel and consonant tally
prompt: Go through the word keyboard letter by letter. Print how many letters are vowels, then how many are not.

title: Read each entry
prompt: Three entries arrive as text: 8, oak, and 15. For each one in order, print the number it holds, or bad when it holds none.

title: Total of the readable
prompt: The texts 7, x, 9 and ? each may or may not hold a number. Print the total of the ones that do, then how many do not.

title: The longest name
prompt: Among the names fig, banana and kiwi, find the one with the most letters. Print that name, then its letter count.

title: Letters seen twice
prompt: In the word coffee, some letters show up more than once. Print each such letter once, in the order first met, one per line.

title: Words and length
prompt: The phrase is: when in doubt go home. Print how many words it contains, then how many characters it spans including spaces.

title: Digits hiding in text
prompt: The text a1b22 mixes letters and digits. Print the total of all digit characters, then how many digit characters there are.

title: Rectangle report
prompt: A rectangle measures nine across and three down. Print the area it covers, then the total distance around its edge.

title: Three signals in a row
prompt: Signals arrive in the order green, red, yellow. For each one print its meaning: go for green, stop for red, wait for yellow.

title: Stock breakdown
prompt: Two lines are stocked: four units priced three each, and five units priced two each. Print each line's value, then the value of both together.

title: Two lookups
prompt: A list holds just 10 and 20. Look up position one, then position four; print each result, or none when the position is empty.

title: Reading survey
prompt: The readings are 6, 11, 3, 14 and 9. Print how many of them exceed five, then on the next line the highest reading of all.

title: Under the limit
prompt: From the batch 9, 2, 12, 5 and 16, keep every entry under ten. Print each kept entry on its own line, then print how many you kept.

title: Odds doubled, evens summed
prompt: Walk the list 7, 4, 9, 10 in order. Print each odd entry doubled on its own line; after the walk print the total of the even entries.
